key_claims: Mines 212,297 PRs from 12 AI coding agents on GitHub and analyses 30,729 longitudinal interaction timelines. Human triage is very fast. About 73.9% of agent PRs are merged without modification, which the authors call 'silent reliance'. Sentiment analysis across seniority levels: expert developers express more neutral sentiment toward agent PRs, others more positive.
headline_figures: 212,297 PRs; 12 agents; 30,729 interaction timelines; median triage 0.2 hours; 73.9% of agent PRs merged without modification. Comparison group, time window and the denominator for 73.9% (all PRs or merged PRs) [uncertain] not available.
sample_unit_and_population: Pull requests authored by AI coding agents on GitHub (public/open-source presumably) [uncertain]; 212,297 PRs, 12 agents, 30,729 timelines.
observed_vs_stated: Observed behaviour from mined GitHub data (PR timelines, merges, comment sentiment). Not self-report. Sentiment is inferred from text.
what_makes_trust_justified: [uncertain] Abstract page does not state a practice. The framing implies that justified trust would need visible, substantive review rather than merge without modification.
what_it_costs: [uncertain] Not stated. Fast triage (0.2 h median) suggests low human review time per PR.
failure_mode_class: Over-reliance (silent reliance: merging agent PRs unmodified after quick triage).
limitations_stated: [uncertain] Not available without full text. The abstract notes future research directions.
counter_evidence: Unmodified merge does not prove no review happened: reviewers may have read and approved without edits, and a small, easy PR may deserve quick merge. Merge-without-modification is a proxy for reliance, not a measure of review depth. [uncertain] this is my inference, not from the paper.
verification_status: Figures checked against the ICSE JAWs program page abstract only, via a summarising tool; not against the full paper. Seniority-verification finding is only a sentiment result in the abstract, nothing on verification behaviour by seniority. [uncertain]
usable_claim: A 2026 workshop paper reports that, across 212,297 agent-authored GitHub PRs from 12 agents, 73.9% were merged without modification and median human triage took 0.2 hours, which the authors describe as silent reliance. Expert developers' comments were more neutral in sentiment than others'.
do_not_use: Any claim that senior developers verify more or less carefully (not supported by the abstract; only sentiment is reported). Do not call the 73.9% a 'no review' rate. Do not cite the 'it was peer reviewed in full' status or any figure beyond the abstract until the full text is read.
overlap_with_existing_essays: [uncertain] Not checked against the Verification Gap or Checking Isn't Catching essays in this task.
